note: Competency questions (Grüninger & Fox style): natural-language questions the KG claims should be able to answer via the listed predicates. scripts/validate_ontology.mjs reports, per question, whether any qualifying claim exists and whether at least one is source_verified (vs. only expert/inheritor-review-required or access_pending).

questions.question: What materials or substrates does this heritage item use?
What techniques and processing steps does this heritage item require?
Who is the recognized inheritor, and how is transmission of the craft supported?
Where and under what official registration/protection status is this heritage item recognized?
Is this heritage item the same craft as a related but distinct craft, and how do they relate materially?
What aesthetic qualities result from this heritage item's technique and material choices?
What access conditions or reuse constraints govern a given public dataset?
What historical origin is claimed for this heritage item, and what cultural context surrounds it?
